$comment: The lexicon of word tiles (docs/design/holding.md "Plots", M2 Task 5; LORE §4.5 and §14.3): M2's two words only, the rest of LORE's 30 come with the tasks that give them effects. id: the transliteration in kebab-case, permanent (stored in known_words and plots); letters: the base Old Letters as the Writ stores them (shapeLetters adds the final forms), every word through the safe-letters filter; say: how it is said; meaning: its gloss; slot: ground (what a plot is for; builds a plot kind) or virtue (asks something extra of it; has an effect); element: earth | water | fire | air (the seal's colour and the sigil's line style); card: LORE's card text, word for word. A Ground has builds (a plot kind of stations.json); a Virtue has effect: yield-per-day is +permillePerDay of the basket cycle's yield for every whole day the plot has kept its Virtue, up to maxPermille (GAME DESIGN: +1% a day up to +20%). Don't reword a card.

words.card: "Tilled ground." Ground that's ready to be worked. Earth.
"Old." A Virtue. Things that keep their name a long time grow richer. Earth.
